remarks: Welcome to your new custom-built modern farmhouse at 7394 Maple Road in the Town of Newstead! This brand-new 2026 construction home offers ~1,600 sq ft of thoughtfully designed living space on a spacious 1.4-acre rural lot (not wooded, with open usability). Served by highly rated Akron Central Schools, it’s perfect for anyone seeking peaceful country living with everyday convenience. Enjoy one-floor living with a first-floor primary suite featuring a private en-suite bath and spacious dressing room. The bright open eat-in kitchen boasts a large island—ideal for meals and entertaining. Highlights include first-floor laundry, 2.5+ baths, versatile upper bedrooms, and abundant natural light. Outside, the 1.4-acre rural lot offers privacy and room for gardening, play, or relaxation on the covered back patio. Built with modern amenities, energy-efficient features, and timeless farmhouse charm, this move-in-ready home delivers quality and value. In desirable Newstead with easy access to amenities, this property blends rural space and convenience. A rare opportunity from Marzec Homes! Tax shows 0 sq ft. Seller provided 1600 sq ft.
